notes.title: Autumn Update 2023
notes.content:
[list]
Hello!

Current patch fixes some of SteamVR frame rate compatibility issues that some users have reported.
Also Vive Focus 3 controller support added, for those of you who are using Vive Business Streaming.

Cheers and have fun!


v04.09.2023.1 Changes

- Overall compatibility fixes
- Vive Focus 3 controller support added
[/list]
